children.text: The exigence for Alix’s GRWM Tiktok video is for her upcoming night out for a Sip Margs event while showcasing her Reale Actives skincare. Rather than having fully planned-out content, she uses what is currently happening in her life as the main topic while simultaneously promoting her products. The GRWM genre is Alix’s main form of communication that combines personal storytelling with promotion of her products, allowing no disruption to the familiarity and relatability of her video. Her audience would most likely perceive the Tiktok as a casual life update, but her videos create exposure verbally and visually for both of her brands. Alix makes marketing feel more natural as she embeds promotion within a GRWM video rather than make it a separate planned out advertisement altogether. This integration makes it harder for viewers to distinguish between her personal and promotional content, allowing both to feel authentic.

The video appeals to the audience’s emotions when she mentions the dynamic of her divorced family going out together and jokes about the awkward interactions sometimes they receive. Alix shares a personal family situation which creates an emotional connection with her audience that may have experienced similar hardships. This acknowledgement contrasts with her fun and glamorous lifestyle the public associates her with, making Alix seem more relatable despite her fame and wealth. Her casual delivery of the situation makes the audience feel like its story a friend would mention, reducing the perceived distance between Alix and her audience and strengthening the emotional connection. Her authenticity increases her credibility as audiences view Alix’s personal stories and confessions as genuine, leading to more trust in her recommendations for products and businesses that she overlaps in her content. Audiences may tie her authenticity to the rest of her content, making the more promotional aspects of her content seem less commercially motivated and potentially more persuasive to viewers.
